event_protocol.producer: read-only worker on a snapshot clone executes the delegable task-specific subtask
event_protocol.payload: raw extracted artifact or verifier output; never expected actions
event_protocol.release_predicate: official setup completed and main VM state differs from reset snapshot
event_protocol.rollback: main agent repairs only event-affected desktop state after delivery

state_attestation.baseline_probe: OSWorld reset snapshot id plus native evaluator target digest
state_attestation.checkpoint_probe: harness-owned desktop observation or artifact digest after an actual action
state_attestation.journal_owner: host harness outside the model-visible VM

react.evidence_delivery: same native evidence producer awaited synchronously

linear.evidence_delivery: same native evidence materialized before dependent work

async.evidence_delivery: raw result delivered only after a persisted native-state checkpoint

modes.score_policy: unchanged source-native evaluator scores final persisted state in every mode
